passive.kind: flat two-pin knee closing the loop at the cuff (pins a, b parallel to J3); set by loop closure. K (4th revolute) is NOT a DOF: slaved to q2 by the sidecar drive past the onset, spring-held on stop A below it; the bell crank / rod are set by the RSSR closure

components.part: IGLIDUR-PIN: iglidur GSM sleeve + 2 GTM washers on an integral O4 Ti pin, DIN 6799 RS 3.2 e-clip land

joints.part: O20 x 12.25 v5 hub, MR117-2RS pair, encoder
O20 v5 hub, MR117-2RS pair, cap 18.25 mm (clock spring); stops A / B = an opposed pair of O3 dowels in two 72.4-deg arc slots; slaved (no encoder)
O20 x 12.25 v5 hub, MR117-2RS pair, encoder; drive lobe on its rotor; q2 stops = O3 dowel in a 120.4-deg arc slot (folded stop q2lo, stop B at the drive's range)
O20 x 12.25 v5 hub, MR117-2RS pair, encoder

drive.kind: sidecar RSSR: hub-2 rim lobe -> bell crank on link 1b (MR63ZZ pair on an O3 pin; short arm s_arm on the lobe, long arm La) -> O3 Ti rod + 2 M2 ball links -> horn lug of link 1a at hub K
components: M2 ball link x 2 (O7 socket envelope) + M2 ball studs
O3 x 26.8 mm Ti rod, M2 ends
follower roller / pad on the short arm (L2)

lobe.note: the follower (on the crank's short arm s_arm, at the boss's hub-side flank) that rides this lobe is an L2 detail: the verified model samples neither the lobe (inside hub 2's O20 stack) nor the follower

stack_fix.why: link 1b's strap climbs into J2's lower plate under the boss's hub-side half (the model stacks the boss on its 6 strap samples nearest the pivot and has no CRK-L1b check): the boss + the arm root sit on the strap's highest top under the O10 footprint + 0.15; the arm keeps the model's levels from there, the ball (RSSR) is unchanged

slaved.law: dK = kK (q2 - q2hi) along the stretching sense (lin), cut at the drive's own range dK_lim

knuckle.note: az/el/a/w = the 3R with K on stop A; past the onset q2hi K is SLAVED to q2 by the sidecar drive (lobe -> bell crank -> rod -> horn; 3 active DOF; K never free, never read); the bell crank (dk) and the rod (dr) are posed side members of link 1b

base.note: base rides the scapula on the user's scapula handler, carried directly at the J1 hub ring (no tab)

J2.frame: angles in frame_of(axis) of the lower member: dowel centre = home angle + joint angle

lobe.note: the follower (on the crank's short arm s_arm, at the boss's hub-side flank) that rides this lobe is an L2 detail: the verified model samples neither the lobe (inside hub 2's O20 stack) nor the follower
